drafts.caption_en:
More than 500 investors surveyed, roughly two-thirds say AI can help. Charles Schwab's answer: put an AI assistant straight into its own app.

On September 30, Schwab unveiled Charley, a generative AI assistant rolling out in phases starting in October to eligible U.S. retail clients on Schwab.com and Schwab Mobile.

What Charley does:
- Take questions by voice or text, in your own words
- Give you information and suggested next steps
- Complete select tasks
- Connect you with a Schwab representative when needed

Schwab's survey alongside the launch (September 21 to 25, more than 500 Schwab clients and prospects): about two-thirds of retail investors say AI can handle routine tasks, or play a meaningful role in investing when paired with human expertise.

The key word is "paired." The big-broker direction isn't letting AI pick stocks for you. It's handing off the lookup-and-sort chores so people keep their time for judgment.

But Charley only serves Schwab's U.S. clients. If you follow both Taiwan and U.S. stocks, MarketDaily is another version of the same idea: set your holdings (up to 80), and Monday to Saturday at 7 AM the news and earnings reminders tied to them land in your inbox, already sorted. Every user gets exactly the same analysis, and losing calls stay on the public track record too.

All features are free for a limited time, no credit card required. When paid plans return, early-bird subscribers who join now keep free access permanently.

Would you rather ask an AI about your holdings by voice, or get one sorted email in the morning? Tell me below.

drafts.caption_zh:
一句 prompt,讓 AI 從「拍你馬屁」變成「列出 3 個看空理由」。

問 ChatGPT「我這檔持股好不好」,它很容易先順著你講。換個問法,它就會開始替你做真正的功課。

📋 直接複製這段:
「請扮演一位持懷疑態度的研究員。我持有〔公司名〕。不要評價我的決定好或壞,直接列出 3 個這家公司未來表現可能不如預期的理由。每個理由附上:① 我該觀察的具體指標 ② 可以去哪份公開資料查證(財報、法說會、重大訊息)。資料不足就直接說不知道,不要猜。」

接著三步:
1️⃣ 把〔公司名〕換成你自己的持股
2️⃣ 追問一句:「這 3 個理由裡,哪一個最容易被我忽略?為什麼?」
3️⃣ 把它列的指標抄下來,下次財報公布時逐一對照

⚠️ AI 會講錯。它給你的是一張功課清單,不是答案,也不是買賣建議;每一條都要回原始資料查證。

這份功課每天自己做很花時間。MarketDaily 週一到週六早上 7 點,把你自選持股(美股+台股,最多 80 檔)的相關新聞、財報提醒、板塊輪動整理好寄到你的信箱。所有分析內容對全體用戶完全相同。

drafts.caption_en:
One prompt that turns AI from flattering you into listing 3 reasons to be bearish.

Ask ChatGPT "Is my stock a good pick?" and it tends to agree with you. Change the question and it starts doing real homework for you.

📋 Copy this:
"Act as a skeptical researcher. I hold [company name]. Don't judge whether my decision is good or bad. List 3 reasons this company could underperform expectations. For each reason, give me: ① the specific metric I should watch ② which public source I can verify it in (earnings reports, earnings calls, official filings). If the data isn't enough, say you don't know. Don't guess."

Then three steps:
1️⃣ Swap [company name] for one of your own holdings
2️⃣ Follow up: "Which of these 3 reasons am I most likely to overlook, and why?"
3️⃣ Write down the metrics it lists and check them one by one when the next earnings report comes out

⚠️ AI gets things wrong. What it gives you is a homework list, not an answer and not a buy or sell call. Verify every point against the original source.

Doing this homework yourself every day takes time. MarketDaily sends the news, earnings reminders and sector rotation for your watchlist (US + Taiwan stocks, up to 80 tickers) to your inbox at 7 AM, Monday to Saturday. All analysis is exactly the same for every user.

"Sources say." "Reportedly." How many of the market headlines you scrolled past today started like that?

Before MarketDaily's AI picks a story, it has to clear three checks:

One change, in caption_en only: replaced "anonymous sources" with "allegedly" in check 2. Reason: config.VAGUE_KEYWORDS has no English keyword "anonymous sources". Product claims match docs/pricing.html: Mon-Sat 7 AM (pricing line 707 / EN 866), up to 80 holdings, no credit card, free for a limited time, and early-bird wording matching the official line.
(2) zh and en agree, including the Mon-Sat schedule.
(3) No banned wording: no win rate or subscriber counts, no Pro, trial, invite code, guarantee language, AI calling itself a teacher, or LINE. The two quoted rumor examples are generic and name no stock.
(4) Nothing in latest_spy_report.json overlaps this copy.
(5) compliance_selfcheck.check_caption returns all True for zh, the original en, and the fixed en.
(6) Not a news-hook draft (no source_url).
(7) Not a comment-gate CTA, so the marketdaily.ai URL is allowed.

Not a reason to reject, but worth knowing: ads-score flagged a positioning mismatch. This is a stock-digest promo going to the Threads account, which is now positioned as a world-news account.
